# anywhere in the province, which is what its own tooltip says and what
# `rgo_bonus_filter` already matches on screen.
#

# How many of the chosen method's raw materials this province supplies, and how
# many it wants. The row label prints both, so a location that reaches 5% out of
# a possible 10% does not read the same as one that reaches 5% out of 5%.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_matched_count = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_wants_1
			province = { any_location_in_province = { raw_material = global_var:bag_wtp_wants_1 } }
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_wants_2
			province = { any_location_in_province = { raw_material = global_var:bag_wtp_wants_2 } }
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_wants_3
			province = { any_location_in_province = { raw_material = global_var:bag_wtp_wants_3 } }
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_wants_4
			province = { any_location_in_province = { raw_material = global_var:bag_wtp_wants_4 } }
		}
		add = 1
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_global_variable = bag_wtp_wants_5
			province = { any_location_in_province = { raw_material = global_var:bag_wtp_wants_5 } }
		}
		add = 1
	}
}
